steps.template_en: A linear transformation T:V→W preserves structure: T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v), T(cv)=cT(v). Every linear transformation can be represented as a MATRIX once we choose bases. The matrix depends on the choice of basis.
steps.template_zh: 线性变换T:V→W保持结构：T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v)，T(cv)=cT(v)。一旦选择基，每个线性变换可表示为矩阵。矩阵依赖于基的选择。

steps.template_en: Given ordered bases B={v₁,...,vₙ} of V and C={w₁,...,wₘ} of W, matrix [T]_{C←B} has columns: j-th = coordinates of T(vⱼ) in basis C. Composition ↔ matrix multiplication: [S∘T] = [S][T].
steps.template_zh: 给定有序基B={v₁,...,vₙ}(V)和C={w₁,...,wₘ}(W)，矩阵[T]_{C←B}第j列=T(vⱼ)在基C中的坐标。复合↔矩阵乘法：[S∘T]=[S][T]。

steps.template_en: Change of basis: If P = [id]_{B'←B}, then [T]_{B'} = P⁻¹[T]_{B}P. This is SIMILARITY. Two matrices represent the same linear transformation (in different bases) iff they are SIMILAR.
steps.template_zh: 基变换：若P=[id]_{B'←B}，则[T]_{B'}=P⁻¹[T]_{B}P。这是相似性。两矩阵表示相同线性变换(在不同基下)当且仅当它们相似。

steps.template_en: Rank-nullity: dim(domain)=dim(ker T)+dim(im T). Proof: extend basis of ker T to basis of domain. The images of the extension vectors form a basis of im T. Injective ⟺ ker T={0}; surjective ⟺ dim(im T)=dim(W).
steps.template_zh: 秩-零度：dim(域)=dim(核T)+dim(像T)。证明：将ker T的基扩充为域基。扩充向量的像构成im T的基。单射⟺ker T={0}；满射⟺dim(im T)=dim(W)。

steps.template_en: Linear transformations are the MORPHISMS of vector spaces — maps that 'preserve the structure.' Matrices are a computational tool. The deep idea: study objects through their structure-preserving maps (category theory's core insight).
steps.template_zh: 线性变换是向量空间的态射——'保持结构'的映射。矩阵是计算工具。深层思想：通过保持结构的映射研究对象(范畴论核心洞见)。

steps.template_en: 'Matrix is a representation, not the thing itself': eigenvalues find 1D subspaces invariant under T. Determinants measure how T scales volume. Similarity = same T, different basis. This abstraction is KEY to advanced linear algebra.
steps.template_zh: '矩阵是表示不是事物本身'：特征值找T下不变的一维子空间。行列式度量T如何缩放体积。相似性=相同T不同基。这种抽象是高等线性代数的关键。
